name: Format string vulnerability leaking stack values
topic: Format string vulnerability leaking stack values
description: Format string vulnerability leaking stack values -- a easy-tier binary exploitation challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Format string vulnerability leaking stack values"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
